title: Te Reo o te Tinihanga
intro: I whakamatautauria te hononga whanaungatanga e te ngaru o te hae. I hangaia he mahere huna, i tīmata ai he mekameka o ngā kaupapa ka roa, ka whiti i ngā tawhiti nui. Nā ngā mahi a tēnei rōpū i arahi ki te wehenga nui me te pouri, engari kāore i mutu te kōrero i reira. He kōrero mō te tinihanga, te pouri, me te huraina whakamutunga o te mahere atua. Ka taea e koe te wetewete i te tuakiri o ēnei tāngata, ā, ko ā rātou whiringa i rangona i roto i ngā whakatipuranga?
clues: I horomia mātou e te hae mō te aroha i whakaaturia ki tētahi o ō mātou whanaunga.
I roto i tō māua hae, ka whakatakoto whakaaro māua, ka maka i tō māua teina ki te pōuri o te poka.
Hei huna i tā mātou mahi, i hoatu e mātou he kākahu ki tō mātou matua, he mea poke i te toto rūpahu.
I ngā tau i muri mai, ka akiakihia mātou e te matekai nui ki te haere ki Ihipa ki te rapu kai.
I reira, ka tū mātou ki mua i tētahi kāwana whai mana, kāore mātou i te mōhio, ko ia tonu te teina me te tuakana i hara ai mātou.
Ko tā mātou whakamātautau whakamutunga he kawe mai i tō mātou teina whakaotinga, a Pineamine, ā, i puta ai te whakakitenga mai o tō mātou hītori me tō mātou matua, ko te Poropiti a Hākupa.

identity.label: Ko wai tātou?
options: Ngā Tama a Ātama (Qabil rāua ko Habil)
Ngā Ākonga a te Poropiti a Ihaia
Ngā tuakana o te Poropiti a Hohepa
Te Iwi o Madyan
Ngā Tohunga Makutu o Fir'awn
identity.answer: Ngā tuakana o te Poropiti a Hohepa

trial.label: He aha tā tātou mahi hē matua?
options: Te hanga i tētahi kuao kau koura hei karakia
Te tono kia kite tika i a Allah
Te tawai i tētahi poropiti mō te hanga i tētahi āka
Te tinihanga i tō mātou matua, te whakarērea i tō mātou teina
Te takahi i te Hāpati mā te hī ika
trial.answer: Te tinihanga i tō mātou matua, te whakarērea i tō mātou teina

location.label: He aha te mea i tino pūtake ai tā tātou tinihanga?
options: He huinga papa tuhituhi
He hāte kua poke i te toto rūpahu
He kuao kau koura
He manu ataahua (te Hupa)
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
location.answer: He hāte kua poke i te toto rūpahu

outcome.label: He aha te mutunga iho o tā tātou kōrero?
options: I whakangaromia mātou e te waipuke nui
I hurihia mātou hei makimaki
I horomia mātou e te whenua
I murua ō mātou hara, ā, i huihui anō mātou ki tō mātou whānau
I toremi mātou ki te moana
outcome.answer: I murua ō mātou hara, ā, i huihui anō mātou ki tō mātou whānau

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verse: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." (12:91)
